test_cases.name: List CBR backups via KooCLI (read-only, limit 1)
test_cases.expected: JSON with a backups list (name/id/status/resource_name/resource_id/resource_type/vault_id) and count

test_cases.name: Backup name list (script, names mode)
test_cases.expected: Header + one '- <name>  (id: <id>)' line per backup, or a friendly empty message

test_cases.name: Resource-type filter (KooCLI native --resource_type)
test_cases.expected: Only backups of OS::Nova::Server resources (or a friendly empty message)

test_cases.name: Resource-name filter (KooCLI native --resource_name)
test_cases.expected: Only backups whose resource_name contains 'ecs-prod' (or a friendly empty message)

test_cases.name: Vault filter (KooCLI native --vault_id)
test_cases.expected: Only backups in the given vault (or a friendly empty message)

notes: 只读操作（CBR ListBackups），无资源创建/修改/删除风险。CLI 路径使用 hcloud CBR ListBackups；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdkcbr。备份名称/状态/所属资源/存储库过滤为 ListBackups 原生查询参数（KooCLI 下划线形态 --resource_type/--resource_name/--vault_id 等），脚本同时做客户端复核过滤。vault_id 为示例值，可替换为真实存储库 ID。
